items.title: Caseys General Stores (CASY) Stock Looks Reasonably Priced On Cash Flow
items.summary: Casey's General Stores has delivered a powerful run in recent years, which naturally puts the focus on whether the cash being generated by the business can support today’s share price. With that kind of backdrop, the key issue for you is whether the current valuation still lines up with the cash flows the chain is expected to produce over time. items.summary: Casey's General Stores (CASY) is back on investors' calendars, with second quarter 2027 results scheduled for release after the close on December 8, 2026.
